g.text: a) 注意极性和位置，如图所示
b) 使用磁棒拾取并放置钕磁铁（2 个北极磁铁 + 2 个南极磁铁）
c) 确保磁铁牢固就位
d) 注意不要悬停在刚安装好的磁铁上方，请“由外向内”操作
a) Pay attention to polarity and location as shown in drawings
b) Use Magnet bar to pick and place the Neodymium magnets (2x North + 2x South)
c) Make sure the Magnets are well-seated
d) Pay attention not to hover over the recently installed Magnets ""Outside to inside appraoch"
